7.7.8 Aging of diagnostic events
The Dem module provides the ability to remove a specific event from the event memory, if its fault conditions are not fulfilled for a certain period of time (operation cycles). This process is called as "aging" or "unlearning". Process aging Process healing WarningIndicatorOffCriteriaFulfilled! Event memory entry exists? WarningIndicatorOnCriteriaFulfilled?
